WITH OrderInvoiceCounts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
), OrderShares AS (
    SELECT order_id, invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM OrderInvoiceCounts
), AverageShare AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM OrderShares
)
SELECT SUM(os.invoice_count) AS total_number_of_invoices,
       a.avg_share AS average_share,
       AVG(os.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM OrderShares os
CROSS JOIN AverageShare a
WHERE os.share > a.avg_share
